applies_to: Thermal Solutions / Bryan Steam Conductor EMS boiler sequencers (up to 8 boilers) connected to BACnet through the ProtoAir FPA-W44 gateway.
summary: Conductor EMS is the master boiler sequencer for Thermal Solutions and Bryan Steam plants. Through the ProtoAir FPA-W44 gateway it reports plant load, sequencer status and setpoint, system supply/return/outdoor temperatures, steam pressure, discrete outputs and system alarms, plus a block of 23 points for each of up to eight boilers. The BMS can enable the sequencer (BV 0) and write its setpoint (AV 0); everything else is read-only Analog Inputs, including on/off states and alarm flags.
notes: Object names, types, instances and access are from section 12.11; on/off states and alarm flags are Analog Inputs reading 0 or 1.
Boiler state, lockout and hold codes (AI 47-49 and the matching objects for boilers 2-8) use the code tables printed for Sola, TSBC, S7800 and hardwired boilers; the tables are not repeated here.
Boiler 2-8 rows in the manual have no descriptions; they follow the boiler 1 block.
Boiler cycle counters are AI 212-219 and run times AI 220-227.
The same manual covers other Thermal Solutions/Bryan controls that are separate lists in this library.

source.title: Operating Manual, ProtoAir FPA-W44 for Interfacing Bryan Steam & Thermal Solutions Products

integration.summary: Cut jumper 1 on PCB-10 so BV 0 can enable the sequencer, then enable it and write the plant setpoint to AV 0. Read the active setpoint, firing rate, system temperatures, sequencer status and the per-boiler alarm flags.
integration.enable: BV 0 EMS_Enable turns the master sequencer on; jumper 1 on PCB-10 must be cut first.
setup: The ProtoAir FPA-W44 gateway is set up through its web configurator; see the general sections of the same manual.
gotchas: Alarm and on/off points are Analog Inputs (0/1), not Binary objects.
Repeat the boiler alarm mapping for each installed boiler (blocks of 21 from AI 36).
